refresh_note: Intraday chart snapshot for the technical tab. Regenerate every 30 minutes during trading (same cadence as data.json). For each dashboard symbol call the Yahoo chart API twice: GET https://query2.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/<yahoo_symbol>?range=1d&interval=5m&includePrePost=true for range key "1d" (the Hebrew יום button) and ?range=5d&interval=15m&includePrePost=true for range key "1w" (the שבוע button). query1.finance.yahoo.com is an interchangeable mirror - if one host answers 429 Too Many Requests, switch to the other and back off a few seconds; send a browser User-Agent header. Bar schema: rows are [t, close, volume] where t is the Yahoo timestamp entry = Unix epoch seconds UTC, close is quote.close rounded to 4 decimals (skip bars whose close is null; TASE prices stay in agorot, e.g. ENLT 22420 = 224.20 ILS), volume is quote.volume or 0 when null. The UI formats t in Asia/Jerusalem, so keep epoch seconds - do not convert to local strings. includePrePost=true adds US pre/post-market bars so the day view fills before the 16:30 Israel open. Symbol map (dashboard key = Yahoo symbol): NASDAQ:CIFR=CIFR, NASDAQ:IREN=IREN, NYSE:CLS=CLS, NASDAQ:ACMR=ACMR, NASDAQ:META=META, NASDAQ:ADEA=ADEA, TASE:ENLT=ENLT.TA, SP:SPX=^GSPC, NASDAQ:NDX=^NDX, DJ:DJI=^DJI, TVC:GOLD=GC=F, TVC:USOIL=CL=F, TVC:US10Y=^TNX, COINBASE:BTCUSD=BTC-USD, TASE:TA35=TA35.TA, TASE:TA125=^TA125.TA. IBI:2126 and IBI:5143078 are intentionally absent (Bizportal is end-of-day only; the UI shows its no-intraday note for them). Quirks: before the US session, ^GSPC/^NDX/^DJI return an empty 1d result (rows=[]) while ^TNX returns its previous session - both are fine to write as-is; empty rows make the UI show its pre-open note. Rows stay sorted oldest-to-newest exactly as Yahoo returns them. Added 2026-09-14: TVC:US30Y=^TYX, same recipe as TVC:US10Y=^TNX. TVC:US02Y and TASE:1227784 are intentionally absent (FRED DGS2 publishes once per business day; Bizportal is end-of-day only) - the UI shows its no-intraday note for them.
